items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: I went back to New York and luckily I got a job as a staff musician playing for the “Kate Smith Show.”

ctx.x: I was finished with the big band. Vaughan broke up then. I went back to New York and luckily I got a job as a staff musician playing for the “Kate Smith Show.”
So what network was that on?
